evals.prompt: Retrieve and rate literature for a data-driven forecasting problem, then emit structured evidence.
evals.expected_output: Success returns literature_evidence.json with 5-8 selected papers, venue tiers, and per-subproblem coverage.
assertions: never includes a paper whose year is later than the contest year
assigns venue_tier and score to every selected paper
coverage maps every subproblem to at least one paper
method_evidence_map is non-empty and feeds method-matcher
marks skipped=true with a reason instead of fabricating DOIs when no results
